desc: The Kimber Independence is Kimber's latest commemorative edition and the first compensated special edition. Featuring a patent-pending proprietary compensator, this limited edition Independence model is chambered in .45 Auto and is a testament to celebrating the July 4th holiday with a custom-tailored Cerakote finish. The Independence also features slide lightening cuts and a port along the forward top strap. Racing serrations at the rear of the slide are designed to mimic the flag's movement that adorns the entire pistol. The Kimber commemorative special edition Independence is a spectacular custom handgun that will be an heirloom for generations.
